policy_objective: minimize local rebuild time and server rounds while preserving only causal release blockers

gates.blocking_effect: Invalid identity/bootstrap can prevent the unique runner from starting or prevent a return from binding to this package.

A diagnostic package with free-form or unresolved HDL names can fail production compile; an incomplete source-bound candidate matrix can make its return ambiguous. Every next-fresh DUT-simulation package must materialize one fresh generated observer receipt before expensive staging.
Broken runner control flow can skip compile/simulation or bypass the shared return finalizer.

The exact nounset runner must define package-owned variables before first reachable expansion and preserve bounded compile argv/source/log/first-error evidence in a bootstrap-safe core return; otherwise the package can stop before simulation or return only compile=2 without a root cause.

A package-owned prelaunch server file, directory, tool, library or module-provider existence probe can stop the runner before the real production command. The exact runner must contain one # CODEX_PRODUCTION_LAUNCH marker, arm its return finalizer, launch production directly, and let actual cwd/argv/log/exit adjudicate the environment.
Invalid package-local HDL can fail production compile or elaboration before simulation starts.
The exact final ZIP must recompute an empty aggregate of reserved SystemVerilog declaration identifiers for every package-local HDL member; otherwise production compile can stop before simulation.
Materialized config paths or bytes can make the test open the wrong input or violate the declared runtime address/lifetime state.
Only result-critical diagnostic semantics are blocking; their failure makes the returned classification ambiguous or false.

After simulation exits, the exact shared JSON-only return core must persist the simulator receipt before optional analysis and publish a minimal return even when a plugin fails; otherwise completed DUT evidence can be lost.
A broken return/result contract can lose required evidence or publish a non-canonical result.

The exact final ZIP must byte-match regenerated observer/parser/binding artifacts and expose the fixed compile, runtime-enable, log and decision-return tokens; otherwise a post-generation family edit can reintroduce compile failure or ambiguous return evidence.

Every next-fresh DUT-simulation package must use DUMP_VCD=0/DUMP_FSDB=0/TB_DUMP_FSDB=0 and reject VPD/FSDB/VCD/FST or dump/query assets. The exact final ZIP must bind a source-derived 26-role actual-signal catalog, pairwise-distinguishing candidate-by-boundary matrix, ordered unbounded four-state event chunks, end states, simulation-time heartbeat, canonical parser/decision and exact return member set. Decimal 100000000 bytes is warning-only for observer evidence and never a hard cap. The exact package_tools/server_post_sim_return.py may retain only contract-bound inert historical suffix literals when its bytes equal the canonical helper and the exact request omits/nulls waveform_discovery; writer/control scans and all active surfaces remain fail-closed. The generic child-subreaper supervisor must terminate and reap the simulator tree and close/flush observer chunks before publication. Compile-not-started preserves the independent compile-core exemption; simulation-started incomplete observer evidence fails closed while retaining partial observer/core return.

After embedded manifest promotion to PACKAGE_READY_NOT_RUN, the package-specific runtime preflight must pass on final staging and on a clean extraction of the exact final ZIP. Every package-local Python source must be discovered as a byte-equal staging/ZIP exact set and py_compile successfully without package-tree bytecode. The schema-enabled admission runtime must import jsonschema and validate the contract; missing dependency, skip or schema failure is blocking. A real PACKAGE_READY_NOT_RUN_LOCAL_BUILD_PENDING_GATES mutation must fail with package claim boundary differs; positive assertions and observed-negative facts use separate typed polarity, and precompile failure preserves stdout, stderr and exit in the compile-not-started core.

The clean exact final ZIP must prove release-critical nested statuses are terminal, selected and absolute wall identities agree across every declared member while preserving their distinct roles, every required in-ZIP return member has one exact prepublication producer, guard completion precedes immutable publication, postpublication durable/cleanup receipts remain external, and progress counters bind qualified actual-source events with a held-level non-progress replay.

Only when selected_mode is TB_VCD_BOUNDED_CAUSAL_CONE, the exact final ZIP must select exactly one bulk-evidence mode, use package-local TB standard dump tasks with all Make dump variables zero, bind the complete source-derived causal cone and pairwise candidate matrix, and require the expanded $dumpvars target union to equal the exact source-bound catalog with module/aggregate over-dump forbidden. The first diagnostic round binds an exact current-family round-three-or-later breadth receipt and a reasonable signal-count range as a soft reference; being below or above the range is not a standalone blocker when relation, explanation and acknowledgement are recorded. A source-bound zero-hop driver for every HIGH candidate is a strong coverage target; a missing driver is a record-only gap while the candidate matrix remains distinguishable. A refined successor binds its exact predecessor, exact add/remove/unchanged signal diff, candidate preservation or closure and unchanged source identity. Family-adaptive signal pruning records reason, HIGH or MEDIUM confidence and affected candidates; LOW confidence retains the signal, without requiring per-signal proof over every preserved candidate. Freeze consumes appended VCD timestamps, heartbeat is unsigned width>=64 at 16384 owner cycles, inline/multiline timescale is accepted, and target claims require live entry/downstream/first-error evidence. The shared evaluator receipt is the sole outer-runner decision authority; exact helper replay must prove advancing timestamp and suspected-only plateau continue while full plateau and true freeze stop. Quiescent archived VCD full-file SHA/bytes/last timestamp must bind final runtime. Partial, unflushed, unreaped or non-exact-set evidence cannot pass finalization; strict plateau and independent wall/size/disk safeguards remain fail-closed. Observer-only packages do not run this gate.

The first fresh package per affected family after a rule/shared-tool epoch is independently re-audited from a clean extraction of the exact final ZIP. It must rerun package release admission after manifest promotion, including the real pending-status negative, then aggregate actual runner/input, generated logger-to-collector-to-parser, post-sim return-core and candidate-matrix failures before upload; noncausal findings remain record-only.
The exact final ZIP is the server-consumed object; unsafe or missing final members can affect start, input, state isolation, or return.

Runtime layout controls actual open paths, package-owned state isolation, exact-runner early failure stderr visibility for next-fresh runner changed-surfaces, exact generated-heredoc syntax, and fixed return publication; a silent nonzero exit or broken finalizer fallback can prevent server start or lose required return decisions.
Storage rotation prevents ambiguous current pickup and accidental overwrite of pending/tested package state.
Formatting and intermediate summaries do not change server execution or return adjudication.
